content:
Apple TV kicked off its best summer lineup ever last week with thriller series Cape Fear, and today the streamer released trailers for two returning shows coming soon.

#1: Trying season 5

One of my all-time favorite Apple TV comedies—Trying—is coming back soon.

Trying season 5 premieres Wednesday, July 8 with one episode, followed by weekly releases through August 26.

If you’re a fan of heartwarming comedies along the lines of Ted Lasso and Shrinking, I highly recommend checking out Trying.

The show centers on a London-based couple, Nikki and Jason, on the rollercoaster adventure of trying to expand their family. It has a 96% Rotten Tomatoes score across four seasons so far.

Here’s the new trailer for Trying’s latest season:

#2: Camp Snoopy season 2

Apple TV recently announced a packed lineup of Peanuts additions coming this summer. The first debut is a new season of Camp Snoopy.

Camp Snoopy season 2 is coming on Friday, June 26, with all episodes released at once.

If you’re unfamiliar with Apple’s growing library of Kids & Family programming, it’s well worth checking out if you have kids.

Even if you’re just looking for something to watch yourself, one recent premiere—My Brother the Minotaur—was praised as worthy viewing for all ages.
